name: offline-unknown-result-reconciliation
objective: الحفاظ على offline queue الحالية وإغلاق unknown-result/reconciliation وactor/installation/restart semantics دون إعادة بناء أو retry أعمى.
truthOwner: DSH owns canonical mutation state; field offline queue owns durable delivery/retry state only.

tasks.objective: Add/verify canonical reconciliation before retry for ambiguous field mutations while preserving proven queue behavior.
tasks.currentProblem: Promise success/failure alone may not distinguish server committed from response lost, so retry can be unsafe in ambiguous cases.
tasks.requiredChange: Define per-operation authoritative reconciliation, persist enough correlation/idempotency state, and cover network-loss/restart/account-switch scenarios without touching solved legacy/capacity behavior unless regression appears.
tasks.targetState: UNKNOWN never causes blind duplicate mutation; client reconciles canonical server truth, completes or retries deterministically, and never replays another actor/installation's work.
tasks.action: Trace queue/executors/backend idempotency/read APIs, implement the smallest coherent reconciliation protocol, add fault-injection tests, and verify Operations/Support readback where affected.
mustNotChange: لا إعادة بناء queue من الصفر.
لا حذف legacy quarantine/terminal capacity behavior المثبت.
لا خلط WLT payout reconciliation بهذه queue.
acceptanceCriteria: server committed + lost response لا ينشئ duplicate.
server not committed يعاد بشكل آمن.
wrong actor/installation/account switch لا يعيد work.
tasks.rollback: Preserve queue durability and use forward-fix; never fall back to blind retry after ambiguous result.
